The Moss digest that lists Orlavine at 55 seats is "Moss: Strategic digest 9/30," dated Wednesday, Sep 30 (2026). I replied to Gideon in #strategic-random with that answer.

The 2025 order form says 50 seats, so the 55 may reflect a later change. The 2026 renewal order form also came up in search, but the excerpt I saw cut off before the seat count, so I haven't confirmed the current number.
